worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.summary: Stomp the ground and send a pulse along it; on Electric, Grassy, Misty or Psychic Terrain the wave carries that terrain's element and doubles its power.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.use.1: Amplify power while standing on terrain
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.descripti: Stomp the ground and send a pulse at the target for about %1$s special damage; only when grounded on a terrain does its type follow the terrain and the power double, otherwise it reads as Normal.
After %1$s s of stomping, the wave travels along the ground up to %2$s blocks and settles on the first enemy it reaches.
Resonate sends a second burst out from the landing point after the first, hitting each enemy within a %1$s block radius once more; both waves settle at x0.7.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.preferenc: On: a second ground ring follows the first, each wave at x0.7, good for covering a patch; Off: a single wave at full power, good against one target. Both directions trade area for damage.
Only send the wave within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to send the wave; when off it stays put.
